requirements: Implement the C-end prototype as a usable frontend route.
Do not route mobile users into the code IDE.
constraints: Official GESP sources determine level and official knowledge scope.
Copyright-sensitive problem statements must not be fully republished by default.
Avoid coupling the C-end page to B-end WorkbenchLayout.
insights: A standalone static page is sufficient for first implementation.
The existing router can support /mobile with a small RouteState extension.
Screenshot verification should cover 390px mobile viewport and desktop view.
open_questions: When to connect live catalog/progress APIs.
Whether /mobile should become the root route for public users later.
